conventions.manuscript: Ch1 (fields, pairing Def c1-pairing, Q Prop c1-Q), Ch2 (S^(1), S^(2), eq c2-S1Q, eq c2-S1S, Def c2-S2, Prop c2-special), Ch3 (Q^GF table, Prop c3-P, Prop c3-adjoint), Ch4 (special edge Prop c4-defect1), Ch7 (Def c7-vdot, Prop c7-susy, Prop c7-dil, Prop c7-select, Cor c7-Q/S/K), Ch8 (Def c8-PT, Lemma c8-transfer, Def c8-rep, Thm c8-L, Def c8-components, Cor c8-homotopy, Prop c8-laws, Lemma c8-ev, Def c8-twisted, Thm c8-twist, Prop c8-Tsafe, Def c8-K, Thm c8-K, Cor c8-gram), Ch9 (Prop c9-composite, Prop c9-ward, Thm c9-D1, Prop c9-scheme), Ch10 (letters, pair kernels, Lemma c10-sign, Lemma c10-colour, Thm c10-simplex, Lemma c10-special, Prop c10-genfun, Prop c10-arity1, Prop c10-bound1), Ch11 (Def c11-sp, Thm c11-simplex, Prop c11-k1, Prop c11-position, Prop c11-S, Prop c11-freedom, Prop c11-plane, Rem c11-twist)
conventions.regulator: Schwinger cutoff t_e >= eps on every edge P(eps,T) = int_eps^T (Q^GF (x) 1) K_t dt; special edge K_eps - K_0 with t in [0, eps] and numerator -|l+q|^2 times the fibre factor of K_0; T = infinity along Sigma, Sigma^*, Delta, P_b, rotations (generic momenta, Prop c8-Tsafe); finite T along K_b (Def c8-K), results T-independent (Thm qs-simplex (iv)); NO dimensional regularisation in any role; no IR regulator other than T
conventions.unit: u = hbar tr_g(ad_X ad_Y)/(16 pi^2 (X,Y)) = -g^2 N/(32 pi^2) for su(N); planar adjacent rule of Lemma c10-colour (iv): a term a*hbar/(16 pi^2)*(1 (x) ad_{Y_r}..ad_{Y_1})(-,-)^{-1} gives (-1)^r a/2 units on an adjacent pair, the output of a cubic term of S^(1)(xi) counted among the Y_j (Rem qs-colour)
conventions.names: xi in Sigma: (xi_alpha^i, xibar_alphadot i) along Q^i_alpha, Qbar_alphadot i; eta in Sigma^*: (eta^alpha_i, etabar^alphadot i) along S^alpha_i, Sbar^alphadot i; K_b: v^m = x^2 b^m - 2(b.x) x^m. Q_1, S_1, D_1, K_1, P_1, M_1, R_1 = one-loop components hbar L_1(O)^(1)(x) (Def c8-components); Q alone = linear BV differential; the spinor parameters of Prop c7-susy are never called Q_1, Q_2 in code output

xi in S_+ (x) W.T1: -(Gamma(xi,lam)|_V, A*|_V): slots lamM, AsV, no derivative
xi in S_+ (x) W.T3: 1/2 (rho(dA|_V) xi, lam*): slots AV (one derivative), lamsP
xi in S_+ (x) W.T4: 1/2 (rho(dA|_perp) xi, lam*): slots AW (one derivative), lamsM

terms_of_S1.xi in S_- (x) W^*: same with lamP <-> lamM, lamsP <-> lamsM
terms_of_S1.eta: S^(1)(eta) = sum_mu int x^mu S^(1)(xi_mu) + int s0, xi_mu = rho(e_mu) eta; s0 = -(rho(A|_perp) eta, lam*), slots (AW, lamsP) for eta in S_+ (x) W^*, (AW, lamsM) for eta in S_- (x) W; two-comp s0 = (A^kj eps_ab eta^b_j, lam*^a_k) - (A_kj eps_bdot adot etabar^adot j, lambar*^bdot k)
terms_of_S1.even: S^(1)(x) = int((v.A,A*) - (v.lam,lam*) - (v.c,c*)), Def c7-vdot; K_b two-comp in Rem qs-twocomp
terms_of_S1.realisation: superconformal/model.py: S1_odd(V, Q, eta), S1_even, S2_odd (realisation of Chapter 2, machine-verified there); route B writes its own from Def c8-twocomp and Rem qs-twocomp

conventions.sign_rule: a defect cycle read from X_a with the S^(1)(x) vertex at position s and the special edge e_sigma carries, beyond the sign of Lemma c10-sign, the factor -(-1)^{n(<sigma) + |S1(x)| (n(<s) + [s<sigma])}, |S1(x)| = 0 for odd x, 1 for even x; n(<j) = number of odd outputs before position j. Fix in code against G-cubic, G-pole and G-reg before production (E0).
conventions.canonical_form: two-leg outputs on plane waves: alpha delta + beta^mu d_mu delta + gamma^{mu nu} d_mu d_nu delta; int omega (x^mu x^nu K_munu + x^mu K_mu + K_0) <-> K_0 = alpha, K_mu = i beta^mu, K_munu = -gamma^munu (Prop qs-K (i), audit G5)

definitions.defect_cycle: chain X_a - e_0 - V_1 - ... - V_n - e_n - X_b with vertices of I and EXACTLY ONE term of S^(1)(x) (placements: on a line = both legs on P [T1 along Sigma, (AV,AsV) along even x]; at the special edge = one leg on K_eps - K_0 [any quadratic term]; cubic T5 with two cycle legs, third leg an output), edges P and EXACTLY ONE special edge (Def qs-defect)
definitions.D_x: D_x(X_a,X_b;eps,T) = sum of the defect cycles of the pair, amputated, outputs open (Def qs-defect (ii))
definitions.finite_special_vertex: F_x(X_a,X_b) = - sum_{m>=1} ((-1)^m/m!) ( {I, ct1_{x,m}(X_a X_b)}_{H^m} + {S^(1)(x), ct_m(X_a X_b)}_{H^m} ), {,}_{H^m} built from (H^m (x) 1) K_0 (eq qs-finitesp)
definitions.component: hbar L_1(O)^(1)(x) = sum_{a<b} (Koszul) int omega ... Upsilon_x(X_a,X_b) ... - {hbar F_1^(1)(x), O}, for EVERY local O (gauge-variant included), Thm qs-classes (iii), (v)
definitions.counterterm_cycles: same chains with one S^(1)(x) on the cycle and no special edge; ct1_x(X_aX_b) = hbar Sing_eps of them; outputs of pair degree minus one (Def qs-ct1)
definitions.commutators: C_xi = [xi., Q^GF] (components lam->c: d^*(Gamma(xi,lam)|_V) = -i(p,Gamma(xi,lam)|_V); A*->lam; lam*->A; c*->lam*; zero on A, c; every component first order); [eta.,H] = 2 sum_mu xi_mu. d_mu; [v.,Q^GF] = 4(b,x)Q^GF + C_K, C_K = 2 sigma^rho(Q^GF)(w b_rho - b_nu Sigma^{rho nu}), C_K A_V = -4(b,A_V); [v.,H] = 4(b,x)H - 4(w-1)(b,d) + 4 b_nu Sigma^{rho nu} d_rho (Prop qs-comm)
definitions.edges: variation kernel V_x = (x. (x) 1 + 1 (x) x.)P; along xi V_xi = (C_xi g(H) (x) 1)K_0, components lam(x)A, A(x)lam, c(x)lam*, lam*(x)c; composite line along xi = 2(P* xi. P* (x) 1)K_0, components c(x)lam, lam(x)c, a multiple of xi_alpha^i e^{-2 eps p^2}/p^2 (Rem qs-twocomp); [Q, P* xi. P*] = (e^{-eps H} - e^{-T H}) C_xi g(H) != 0 (Cor qs-edges)
definitions.position_decomposition: eta: Upsilon_eta = x^mu Upsilon_{rho(e_mu) eta} + Upsilon^0_eta, the intrinsic part = -i d/dr_mu at r = 0 of the cycles with S^(1)(rho(e_mu)eta) and momentum r injected at the S vertex (carried by e_s..e_n to X_b and omega), plus the cycles with s0. K_b: v(x_O + z) = v(x_O) + (-2(b,x_O) z + omega_{x_O} z) + v(z), omega_{x_O} z = 2((x_O,z) b - (b,z) x_O): Upsilon_K = v(x_O)^mu Upsilon_{P_mu} - (b,x_O) Upsilon^0_Delta + Upsilon^0_{M omega} + Upsilon^0_K; z^mu z^nu -> -d^2/dr_mu dr_nu, z^mu -> -i d/dr_mu (Prop qs-posdec)

theorems_to_use.simplex: Thm qs-simplex: n vertices (k_I of I + the S vertex), n+1 edges; 16 pi^2 [eps^-m] = (1/m) int_{alpha_sigma smallest} [(min_{f!=sigma} alpha_f)^m - alpha_sigma^m] F_m; 16 pi^2 [eps^0] = int_{alpha_sigma smallest} F_0 log(min_{f!=sigma} alpha_f/alpha_sigma); NO log eps; F_m = sum_{j >= m+n-1} (Lap^j num)(centre)/(j! 4^j) (-Phi)^{j+1-n-m}/(j+1-n-m)!; along K_b the same coefficients at every finite T
theorems_to_use.genfun: Prop qs-genfun: index m+n-1: (-1)^{m+n-1} e^{i(y,centre)} (|y|/(2 sqrt Phi))^{m+n-1} I_{m+n-1}(|y| sqrt Phi), chain numerator with l -> -i d_y
theorems_to_use.small: Prop qs-small: n=1 (S at the special edge, k_I = 0): alpha in [0,1/2], weight log((1-alpha)/alpha), values in Q + Q log2; n=2 with S on a line: Prop c11-k1 verbatim (beta in [0,1/3], W_0(beta) = (1-beta)log((1-beta)/(2beta)) - (1-3beta)), values in Q + Q log2 + Q log3
theorems_to_use.cubic_example: Example qs-cubic: Aperp -P- T5(AW,AW,lamsP) -special- lamP with output Aperp of momentum q: 16 pi^2 value = (-1/(2 eps) - (3/8)|q|^2) x (T5 factor x fibre factors); contribution to Upsilon_xi(Aperp, lamP) on leg set Aperp: +(3/8)(hbar/16pi^2) d^2(output) x factor; its pole pairs with ct_1 of (lamP,lamP) (leg set Aperp, Table c10-legsets) in eq qs-pole
theorems_to_use.pole_identity: eq qs-pole: sum_pairs ([eps^-m] D_x - sum_{j>=1} ((-1)^j/j!)({I, ct1_{x,m+j}}_{H^j} + {S1(x), ct_{m+j}}_{H^j})) = s ct1_{x,m}(O) + {S1(x), ct_m(O)} - ct_m({S1(x),O}) - ct1_{x,m}(sO)
theorems_to_use.log_covariance: eq qs-logcov: lc({S1(x),O}) - {S1(x), lc(O)} = s lc1_x(O) - lc1_x(sO) + {L^(1)(x), O}, L^(1)(x) = log eps coefficient of I^CT_psl[eps]^(1)(x) (no eps^-m along Sigma, Sigma^*, Delta, P_b, K_b)
theorems_to_use.relations: Prop qs-rel (R1)-(R6): s(component) = 0 on cocycles; {Q1(xi),Q0(xi')} + {Q0(xi),Q1(xi')} + P_1([xi,xi']) ~ 0; {Q1(xi),S0(eta)} + {Q0(xi),S1(eta)} + (1/2)(xi,eta) D_1 + M_1 + R_1 ~ 0; twisted closure Q^xi_0 Q^xi_1 + Q^xi_1 Q^xi_0 = 0; (K_b,P_b') and (eta1,eta2) relations; on colour-singlet families without lambda, c letters the right sides are s-exact and their two-field antifield-free parts vanish on free shell (Lemma qs-onshell)
theorems_to_use.freedom: Prop qs-laws, Thm qs-invariant: field redefinitions, closed directions, G_B, free directions of F^(1)(x) -> one-body changes; finite parts psi' of the output weight -> two-body changes (c_K -> c_K - kappa_B y); cutoff shape = combination of these; invariant: representation on cohomology up to iso and e^{-a hbar B}, [Q^xi_1] on H(Q^xi_0), spectra, the relations of Cor c8-homotopy and Cor c8-gram
theorems_to_use.twist: Prop qs-twist, Thm qs-twistcheck: Q^xi_1 = L_1^(0) + Q_1 - (1/2) L_1^(2)(xi,xi), pair rule; entries beta-gamma, beta-beta, b-gamma, beta-b, b-b arity one, b-c arity two (b = self-dual F) or arity one (b = u_alpha lam*^alpha_4); the comparison holds when the two quantisations differ by an element of C S^xi + Im Q^xi_0; checks (a)-(e)

A.name: exact simplex integrals (extends step2/twoletter/engine_a and step2/composite_qsk/composite/engine_a)
method: chain numerators: vertex functions of I from two-letter engine A (colour-stripped su(2) blocks), terms of S^(1)(x) from superconformal/model.py or rederived from Table qs-terms; special edge with t in [0,eps], numerator -|l+q_sigma|^2 x K_0 fibre factor
Gaussian loop integral; Thm qs-simplex with exact Dirichlet-log integrals over the ordered subsimplices of {alpha_sigma smallest}; Prop qs-small for n = 1, 2
letter derivatives via Prop qs-genfun (Bessel series, index m+n-1)
eta, K_b: injected momentum r at the S vertex, derivatives in r at r = 0 (Prop qs-posdec)
finite special vertices from the arity-zero pair-kernel poles ct_m (two-letter engine A kernels.json) and from ct1_{x,m}
colour (1 (x) ad...)(-,-)^-1 and planar adjacent form; realisations su(2), su(3), gl(3)
A.output_dir: step2/composite_qsk/qsk/engine_a/ (code and caches in src.nosync/, out.nosync/)

B.name: momentum-space numerator algebra + Feynman parameters + numerical eps-extrapolation (extends step2/twoletter/engine_b and step2/composite_qsk/composite/engine_b)
method: independent realisation of S^(1)(x) from Def c8-twocomp / Rem qs-twocomp (two-component, explicit sigma matrices) and of the vertices of I
special edge as the explicit factor (e^{-eps p^2} - 1) times the K_0 component; other edges e^{-eps p^2}/p^2 (T = infinity) or (e^{-eps p^2} - e^{-T p^2})/p^2 (K_b)
Feynman parameters, numerical integration with >= 30 digits (mpmath), eps = eps_0 2^{-j}, Richardson extrapolation of the eps^0 coefficient, poles fitted and compared with route A

second evaluation on F0, F1 (Rem c9-twoeval analogue): Q applied to the arity-one part of O[infty] along xi (Lemma c7-image): graphs with S^(1)(xi) on a leg, on the cycle (line, cubic), on a one-loop subgraph of a leg, with their counterterms; the sum must be local and equal eq qs-decomp
